segments.text:
V. 32.
Learn— parable—Our LORD having ſpoken of the Signs preceding the two grand Events, concerning which the Apoſtles had enquired, begins here to ſpeak of the Time of them. And to the Queſtion propoſed ver. 3. concerning the Time of the Deſtruction of Jeruſalem. He anſwers ver. 34. Concerning the Time of the End of the World, He anſwers ver. 36.
